---
title: "Sankey plot of phages linked to predicted host families"
output: html_document
date: "2026-01-03"
---

```{r}
# Load libraries --------------------------------------------------------------
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggalluvial)
library(stringr)
library(scales)
library(svglite)

# Paths -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Base output dir inside the repository
out_dir <- here("results", "taxonomy")
fig_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "figures")
tab_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "tables")

dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(tab_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Input data inside the repository
phage_results <- here("data", "results_with_metadata.csv")

# Load data -------------------------------------------------------------------
df_all <- readr::read_csv(phage_results, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Host.genus = str_extract(Host.genus, "(?<=f__)[^;]+"),
    Host.genus = case_when(
      is.na(Host.genus) ~ "Unassigned host",
      TRUE ~ Host.genus
    )
  )

# Top more abundant hosts + minor taxa ----------------------------------------
# Exclude Oscillospiraceae from the explicit top list
top_n <- 9
top_hosts <- df_all %>%
  filter(Host.genus != "Oscillospiraceae") %>%
  group_by(Host.genus) %>%
  summarise(total_cpm = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_cpm)) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
  pull(Host.genus)

df_all <- df_all %>%
  mutate(Host.genus = ifelse(Host.genus %in% top_hosts, Host.genus, "Minor taxa"))

# Order + palette
host_order_all <- df_all %>%
  group_by(Host.genus) %>%
  summarise(total_cpm = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_cpm)) %>%
  pull(Host.genus)

host_colors_all <- setNames(hue_pal()(length(host_order_all)), host_order_all)

# Manual tweaks (keep as in your last chunk)
host_colors_all["Unassigned host"] <- "grey55"
host_colors_all["Minor taxa"] <- "burlywood3"
host_colors_all["Bifidobacteriaceae"] <- "#6FA3F7"
host_colors_all["Enterobacteriaceae"] <- "gold"
host_colors_all["Lacnhospiraceae"] <- "gold"          
host_colors_all["Pseudomonadaceae"] <- "#EEE2DF"
host_colors_all["Ruminococcaceae"] <- "#FA6459"
host_colors_all["Streptococcaceae"] <- "pink"
host_colors_all["Bacteroidaceae"] <- "mediumaquamarine"

# Build sankey data -----------------------------------------------------------
sankey <- df_all %>%
  select(vOTUs, Host.genus, mother_infant, bodysite, timepoint_months, CPM) %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint_label = case_when(
      timepoint_months == 0.25 & mother_infant == "infant" & bodysite == "breastmilk" ~ "1 Week Infant – Breastmilk",
      timepoint_months == 1    & mother_infant == "infant" & bodysite == "breastmilk" ~ "1 Month Infant – Breastmilk",
      timepoint_months == 6    & mother_infant == "infant" & bodysite == "breastmilk" ~ "6 Months Infant – Breastmilk",
      timepoint_months == 12   & mother_infant == "infant" & bodysite == "breastmilk" ~ "12 Months Infant – Breastmilk",
      timepoint_months == 0.25 & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "1 Week Infant",
      timepoint_months == 1    & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "1 Month Infant",
      timepoint_months == 6    & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "6 Months Infant",
      timepoint_months == 12   & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "12 Months Infant",
      mother_infant == "mother" ~ "mothers",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(vOTUs, Host.genus, timepoint_label) %>%
  summarise(CPM_sum = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(vOTUs) %>%
  filter(sum(CPM_sum) > 10000) %>%   # keep your threshold
  ungroup()

# Factor orders
host_order_sankey <- sankey %>%
  group_by(Host.genus) %>%
  summarise(total_CPM = sum(CPM_sum, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_CPM)) %>%
  pull(Host.genus)

time_levels <- c(
  "1 Week Infant", "1 Week Infant – Breastmilk",
  "1 Month Infant", "1 Month Infant – Breastmilk",
  "6 Months Infant", "6 Months Infant – Breastmilk",
  "12 Months Infant", "12 Months Infant – Breastmilk",
  "mothers"
)

sankey <- sankey %>%
  mutate(
    Host.genus = factor(Host.genus, levels = host_order_sankey),
    timepoint_label = factor(timepoint_label, levels = time_levels)
  )

# Plot ------------------------------------------------------------------------
p_all <- ggplot(sankey,
                aes(axis1 = timepoint_label, axis2 = Host.genus, y = CPM_sum)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Host.genus), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_stratum(aes(fill = Host.genus), color = "black") +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 5) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("timepoint_label", "Host.genus"),
    expand = c(0.1, 0.1),
    labels = c("Timepoint", "Predicted bacterial host family")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = host_colors_all) +
  labs(
    title = "Sankey plot: core phages linked to bacterial host family across timepoints",
    x = NULL, y = "Total CPM"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_all)

# Save figures ----------------------------------------------------------------
base_name <- file.path(fig_dir, "sankey_plot_all_2")

ggsave(paste0(base_name, ".png"), plot = p_all, width = 18, height = 13, dpi = 300)
ggsave(paste0(base_name, ".pdf"), plot = p_all, width = 18, height = 13)
ggsave(paste0(base_name, ".svg"), plot = p_all, width = 18, height = 13)

# Save table ------------------------------------------------------------------
# summary table used to draw the plot
readr::write_csv(sankey, file.path(tab_dir, "sankey_plot_all_2_data.csv"))
```
